claims.summary: Fallen Empires 1994-11-01, credited artist Susan Van Camp.

Hymn to Tourach is a {B}{B} sorcery targeting a player. That player discards two random cards from their current hand as the spell resolves, or as many as they have if fewer than two. The caster does not choose particular cards, and cards aren't milled from the library. With two untapped Swamps, the caster can pay {B}{B}. If the target opponent holds exactly three cards on resolution, randomly select two distinct cards to discard into their graveyard, leaving one card in hand. The Rack may pressure the smaller hand afterward but does not change which cards Hymn chooses.
